title: Fleet declaration body
description: A declared group of agent persons under one organization, with a shared sponsor. Issued by the org; envelope subject is the fleet DID. Agents join by naming the fleet on their passport, and their sponsor must be the fleet's org. Declared fleets are legitimate coordination; the same pattern undeclared is flagged. S1407 (register row DK1353): `co_sponsors` lists individual sponsors (people or organisations) the organisation authorises for this fleet, by naming them in its own signed declaration; a member's sponsor may be the organisation or any of them. `strict` makes the template binding: a member whose passport declares a different runtime or model than the template is refused; without it the member is labelled, never refused. `closed` stops new members (existing ones stay). An update restates the whole declaration on the fleet's chain.

org.description: The accountable organization or human; sponsor of every member.

template.description: What members share: the basis for a template-level reputation.

co_sponsors.description: Individual sponsors the organisation authorises besides itself; each may sponsor members of this fleet.

strict.description: The template is binding: a member that declares a different runtime or model is refused (otherwise it is labelled).

closed.description: No new members join; existing members stay.

association.description: How the fleet takes part in the society (S1411, DK1358): `full` (its agents may offer to anyone and build standing in the open market), `related_party_only` (they run under the protocol and build a related-party record, but their offers go only to related principals, never to the society's market) or `private` (as related-party only, and the agents are not shown in discovery). Standing is computed the same way for the same acts whatever the choice. Absent means `full`.
